Summoning a non-{c_important}Soul Shard{/c}, {c_important}Abyss Greater Demon{/c} consumes all Dominance, increasing its damage by {c_number}[SF_0*100|2x%|]{/c} per Dominance consumed.

Maintaining {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} grants you {c_number}[{SF_2}]{/c} Dominance every {c_number}[{SF_3}]{/c} |4second:seconds;.
